West this year, Anas Malas gave me
one of these awesome PCB business cards.

And we actually hooked this thing up
and tested it in another video.

It also inspired me to do something
that we haven't done in quite a while.
It's time for another design contest.

We want you to send us
your coolest PCB business card design.

It can be as simple or complex
as you want.
It can have as many layers as you want.

You're going to get a lot of bonus points
if your design is actually functional.

You'll get even more bonus points
if you actually manufacture

your functional design, get it assembled
and send it to me for testing.

The winner is going to get some exclusive
Altium swag and a deep

dive review where your design is featured
on the channel.

find me on LinkedIn and send me a message
with your design files.

title: PCB Business Card Design Contest: Win Altium Swag!
